t: This is St Wilfred's Roman Catholic church, by Kennington Park in Southwark. It was designed by Frederick Walters, a Scottish architect of the Victorian and Edwardian eras who was best known for his Roman Catholic churches. The church takes its name from Saint Wilfrid, a Northumbrian noble who became Bishop of York. He is remembered for speaking up at the Synod of Whitby in 664, where he argued that the Roman method of calculating the date of Easter should be adopted.
